OPERATOR ATTESTATION RECEIVED (2026-08-04): BOTH credentials are confirmed ROTATED — the Anthropic API key and the GitHub Personal Access Token exposed in the purged `129e-…-COMMENT.json` event. Confirmation came via direct operator attestation to this session on 2026-08-04; it is not independently verifiable from the checkout, and is recorded here as the operator fact AC1 required.

The operator also decided (same date) to RE-SCOPE AC3: the push-rejection-surfacing behavior is durable store-level work owned by e7a9-35fa-1d58-4095 (this ticket now `depends_on` it), so AC3 on this incident ticket is satisfied by tracking there rather than by the behavior landing here. The description's AC3 is being reworded accordingly, with the original text preserved inline for history.

With AC1 attested, AC2 verified (see the prior evidence comment: commit 0a09e51c purged, file absent from all `tickets` history, branch in sync with origin), AC3 re-scoped to e7a9, and AC4 satisfied by the decision recorded in e7a9 (scan event payloads at the append seam), all four ACs are met and this incident ticket is closing.
